summary: Bizarre Creations' 2010 arcade racing and vehicular-combat game, blending licensed real-world cars with power-up combat across Windows, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and a Java mobile adaptation.

entries.title: Blur

emulation.emulator: Native Windows / RPCS3 / Xenia / Java ME emulator
emulation.notes: Use Windows for the main route; preserve console/mobile versions only as alternate access paths.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Blur released for Windows, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360, with public sources also identifying a Java mobile version. Windows is the highest-fidelity route for Bizarre Creations' licensed-car power-up racer.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use PS3/Xbox 360 as console alternatives and Java ME only for mobile preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition. The planned sequel was cancelled after Bizarre Creations' closure.
